title: PII at rest unencrypted
description: PII (age/weight/height/gender) stored unencrypted in Hive and SQLite
impact: Device compromise, backups, or forensic extraction reveal PII
remediation: Encrypt Hive userBox with keystore key (done); plan SQLite encryption or column-level crypto
acceptance_criteria: Files at rest unreadable in plaintext; app continues to function; tests pass

title: Missing CI security gates
acceptance_criteria: Add security-audit.yml with semgrep, OSV, detect-secrets; fail on findings
column12: CI runs on PRs and blocks on critical findings

title: Secrets scanning absent
remediation: Add detect-secrets baseline and CI enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Scan runs and blocks new secrets without baseline update

title: Firebase rules/governance unknown
description: API keys/configs committed (expected), but rules may be permissive
remediation: Apply strict Firestore/Storage rules and OAuth client/package/SHA restrictions
acceptance_criteria: Rules tests pass and unauthorized access blocked

title: Minimal observability
description: No crash reporting or security event analytics
remediation: Add Crashlytics/Sentry and basic auth/session analytics
acceptance_criteria: Crashes and events visible; alerting configured
